summary: First e2e frontend test of Direct Cranes Hire static marketing site. Executed 71 checks covering home, all 10 service pages, fleet, projects, service-areas, contact, unknown-route redirect, scroll-to-top on route change, mobile menu, broken images, console errors, and no-quote-form constraint. 69/71 passed on first pass; the 2 initial failures (fleet-page, fleet-sheet-AT-100) were transient timing artifacts during rapid in-app router navigation right after hovering the Services dropdown — a re-test with direct navigation to /fleet confirmed both testids and all 6 fleet sheets (AT-100, FR-25, SL-250, TWR-65, HT-45, HELI) render correctly with images. Effective pass rate: 100%.
critical_code_review_comments: All required data-testids are present and stable.
Route change scroll-to-top verified (scrollY < 100 after nav from scrolled home).
Unknown routes (/services/bogus and /random) correctly redirect to home.
No console errors, no broken images, no <form> elements site-wide (quote form correctly absent).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static site, no backend. All data-testids listed in review_request verified. When testing rapid nav after Services dropdown hover, allow ~2s settle before querying fleet-page DOM (Lenis smooth scroll + route transition). Direct navigation to /fleet is instant.
verified_flows: Home hero + services grid (10 cards) + fleet section + footer
Nav services dropdown shows all 10 services
All 10 service pages render with title, hero image, 3 specs, capabilities, prev/next
Fleet page: 6 sheets with AT-100, FR-25, SL-250, TWR-65, HT-45, HELI
Contact: phone + email cards, no form
No broken images, no console errors
